lines:
Responsibilities: Streams verified portable manifests, branch-separated semantic events, omission/unsupported markers, and permitted artifact metadata into machine-local disposable projection builders without exposing any write or authority surface.
Owned state/contracts: no persistent canonical state. PortableProjectionEnvelopeV1 carries sourceKind=PortableProject, SessionId/ChatId, BranchId, SegmentHash, lineOrdinal, EventId, checkpoint/head hash, projection schema version, and a sanitized semantic payload or explicit Unsupported/Omitted marker. PortableProjectionCursorV1 is the tuple of verified parent-linked object identities, never a timestamp.
Ports: PortableProjectionFeedPort exposes ListVerifiedSessions, StreamBranch, ReadEvidenceDescriptor, and ResumeFromCursor only to aworkit.local_store.query_projections. It requires a current VerifiedPortableBranchHandleV1, streams through verified segment readers, and returns SourceChanged/Quarantined/Unsupported/CatchingUp status explicitly.
Ordering and degradation: each branch follows validated head-record, segment-parent, and line order. Concurrent branches remain distinct result sets; wall-clock and filesystem/Git times are display metadata only. Unknown optional records generate stable placeholders; required-unknown or corrupt records stop at the last verified cursor. Source disappearance or hash change invalidates affected cache rows, never infers history.
Security/performance/NFRs: only export-policy-sanitized fields and bounded inert artifact descriptors/content ranges are exposed; no raw quarantine bytes, secrets, approvals, debug capture, or executable payloads enter FTS. Reads are paginated, cancellable, backpressured, and target incremental p95 projection pages under 100 ms after verification.
Non-responsibilities: no SQLite write itself, canonical event/head write, branch selection/merge, repair, authority, rebinding, side-effect replay, artifact execution, worker/host access, or Git operation.

data.name: Verified Read-Only Disposable Projection Feed
data.technology: Rust read-only streaming adapter from verified portable objects to disposable local projections
